title: Bound the advanced-producer chart-127 repair
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact #7481, this tests one fusion of public1351 MOVEs 38867 and 48154, with the intervening ADD38868 omitted and public1369 ADD52128 and already-paid MOVE52129 advanced. The repair may use all edited chart-127 rows immediately before ADD48155, including both the edited receiver and advanced producer.

The initial rational solver reached the 30-second cap after constructing the bank. An exact sparse integer continuation found a 90-coordinate rational probe that annihilates all 669 edited rows. The historical donor is −1, old1351 is 1, and independent literal forward replay gives old408=1 after ADD48155 versus 0 in the unrepaired edit. The replay checks the unchanged owned1568 version at both producer clocks and the later alignment of role1369. One fixed case exhausted with zero unresolved. Earlier repairs, different routes and other producer encodings remain open.

The hypothetical signed paid delta is −17 rank one, −17 rank four and +17 rank five, with productive ranks fixed. Gross lies in [0.15453192223429987, 0.15453192223429988] raw before repairs. One extra rank-one paid position per native call costs 17 raw across the signed caller. No saving was realized.

## Exact inputs and replay

Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, comparator #7481 at 89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b and signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. #7494 fixes peer itineraries. This test changes an existing producer arrival. The two #7257 CI prerequisites are separate ancestors.

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12 and its standard library, run

    python3.12 -I -B research/p104-advanced-producer-chart127-bound/replay.py

Expected PASS_ADVANCED_PRODUCER_CHART127_BOUND. The continuation and independent replay both exited zero within their 30-second caps. The initial capped receipt is preserved as provenance. Direct and registered replay, exact committed bytes and modes, source history, official read-only Git-free export replay and all 27 local onboarding tests passed on the submitted tree 81bea6cecddad37cdd7bf4c8635a1532198d9758. Hosted checks are separate.
